studies.interpretation: Synthetic mirror-roster pilot, not actual club performance. Within-arm weather/home/halftime effects absent. No persistent histories.
limitations: Small synthetic pilot; intervals may be wider than the proposed 2–4 percentage-point confidence target.
Aggregate serious-foul model only; no explicit retaliation taxonomy.
Severity rates condition on observed foul opportunities; match trajectories and denominators can change.
Paired intervals are approximate; the conservative Wilson combination is the primary interval, especially with few discordant winners.
No player-rating changes, official writes, live weather calls, calibration acceptance or adoption.

archive.contents: Both study manifests, aggregate summaries, and all 2304 compact outcome rows with full-result checksums; full event ledgers are reproducible from the pinned source, inputs and seeds.

decision.confidence: Retain candidate; fresh-seed observed effects are modest but uncertainty does not establish the 2–4 percentage-point target. No coefficient changes.
decision.frustration: Retain conservative candidate; controlled conditional-risk effect is verified, while match-level effects are extremely rare. No coefficient changes.
